description: Explains Suzuki coupling through oxidative addition, transmetalation and reductive elimination; works a para-biaryl aldehyde disconnection and compares limitations with substitution.

historical_claims.anchor: A simplified Suzuki cycle is often described through three main events: oxidative addition, transmetalation, and reductive elimination.
historical_claims.source_locator: Three major simplified cross-coupling catalytic operations.

historical_claims.anchor: One possible disconnection is a Suzuki coupling between four-bromobenzaldehyde and phenylboronic acid
historical_claims.source_locator: Biaryl strategy with para leaving group.
